entry.title: New: Resolution 324 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO THE ISLAND OF HAWAI‘I YMCA FOR THE PURCHASE AND INSTALLATION OF AN ICE MACHINE

Transfers $5,950 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 4)
